ru.What to do, with everything the owner sa: Что сделать, со всем, что для этого сказал владелец

ru.Looks over the projects of deck and tell: Просматривает модули deck и пишет владельцу в ленту, что стоит сделать.
ru.Finds out why a process or a block of a: Выясняет, почему упал процесс или блок экрана модуля, и пишет владельцу в ленту, как исправить.

ru.What deck noticed: result_running, resul: Что заметил deck: result_running, result_not_done или after_not_started

commands.name: reply
commands.title: Reply
commands.description: Answers the owner's messages in a chat topic.

commands.name: work
commands.title: Long work
commands.description: Does a long task of the owner the master handed over from a chat topic, such as rebuilding a module with its renders and self-checks.

task.description: What to do, with everything the owner said that it needs

topic.description: The chat topic the task came from

commands.name: sleep
commands.title: Sleep
commands.description: Once a night goes over what happened since the last sleep: writes, confirms and retires lessons with their source, proposes corrections of the owner's facts and of skills that keep failing the same way, and tidies the indexes.

commands.name: review
commands.title: Daily review
commands.description: Looks over the projects of deck and tells the owner in the feed what is worth doing.

commands.name: on_error
commands.title: Look into an error
commands.description: Finds out why a process or a block of a screen of a project failed and tells the owner the fix in the feed.

project.description: The project with a screen that failed

screen.description: The screen with a block that failed

type.description: The type of the failure of the process, such as script.failed or program.missing

whose.description: Whose the failure is: module, environment or owner

commands.name: on_incident
commands.title: Mend an incident
commands.description: Mends what deck noticed went wrong around a process of a project, such as a result handed in that no step after took, by the incident-recovery skill, and tells the owner in the feed.

incident.description: What deck noticed: result_running, result_not_done or after_not_started

text.description: What deck saw, in its words
